sourceContext.originPage: Contact Us page, "Merchandise & Store Questions" section

visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ-style collapsible items under a section's intro text
notes: Half-width stack on desktop, full width on mobile
Each item header is a grey-filled bar with a dark border and a chevron on the right
24px gap between items; panel expands below its header

contentPattern.structure: One row per item, two cells: title | panel content (paragraphs, lists, links). Example items: Shipping Information, Delivery, Price & Sales Tax, Returns/ Exchanges

suitableFor: FAQ or policy questions below a section's intro copy
short lists of collapsible help topics
notSuitableFor: full-width accordions with bordered panels (use accordion)
